items.title: Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration, court rules
items.summary: On Thursday, a judge ruled that the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic earlier this year was unconstitutional, delivering the AI lab a win in a monthslong rollercoaster of a battle with the Trump administration. items.title: Google’s AI note-taking app now allows you to interact with books
items.summary: Google's AI note-taking app, Gemini Notebook, can now pull information from the books you've purchased. items.title: Hugging Face’s new robot is an adorable rollerskating duck
items.summary: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has launched its second cute AI robot, the Microduck, a one-eyed biped standing just under 10 inches tall. items.title: Adobe is adding more AI to Photoshop
